dedupe_keys.name: thirty years of ground deformation monitoring at stromboli volcano

description: Thirty years of ground deformation monitoring at Stromboli volcano is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Valentina Bruno et al. Since 1992, INGV has collected tilt, GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) and strainmeter data, for the monitoring of effusive and explosive activity of Stromboli volcano. In this timespan, ground deformations related to eruptive activity, paroxystic explosions, cycles of inflation/deflation and many other phenomena of volcanological and geophysical interest have occurred. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: TXT. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 3388232595 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
